title: Tubeless Installation Guide
intro: The tubeless system relies on an airtight seal between the tire, rim, and valve, replacing the traditional inner tube. The process involves three main stages: installation, sealant filling, and inflation.

items.1: Apply tubeless tape tightly, covering the spoke holes.
items.2: Overlap the tape by about 10 cm at the valve hole.
items.3: Pierce a small hole for the valve and tighten the nut by hand only.

install.title: Install the Tire
install.body: Install the tire like a standard clincher. Push the bead into the center channel, or drop center, of the rim to make mounting easier. Massage the tire to ensure even seating.
install.proTip: Use soapy water or mounting fluid on the bead to help it slip into place.

items.1: Inject about 30-60 ml of road sealant through the valve.

inflate.title: Inflate & Shake
inflate.inflate: Inflate quickly. A pump with a reservoir or CO2 inflator can help snap the beads into place. You should hear a satisfying pop.
inflate.shake: Shake the wheel to distribute sealant evenly.
